comments: The accessibility audit is available free in the open-source (Apache-2.0) CLI: https://github.com/kadeep-ai/kadeep-cli (npx kadeep a11y <url>, no account needed). It uses axe-core rules in a real Chromium/Chrome browser via Playwright. KaDeep Studio Pro is the hosted app with paid plans and a free start.
features: KaDeep runs automated WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility checks (axe-core) on live websites and web apps, including localhost and staging, in a real browser session. Available as an open-source CLI command (npx kadeep a11y <url>) and in the hosted KaDeep Studio Pro app, which adds the results to a release go / no-go report.
title: KaDeep Studio Pro
